propositions: The snapshot janitor's reclaim trigger uses a fixed 2 GiB absolute free-space floor that becomes unreachable on 30 GiB volumes, requiring 93.3% disk used to engage while the alarm fires at 85%.

Root disk climbed to 90% during the incident because every review materializes a fresh ~620 MiB copy of the ticket tree on a writable layer, and the janitor never triggered to reclaim it before the alarm floor.
The janitor's 7-day cold-trim exceeds the container lifetime (recreated every hours over 4 days with 23 reclamation events), making it dead code.
A volume-relative reclaim trigger with hysteresis will engage at 80% used (6 GiB free on 30 GiB) and reclaim to 75% used, sitting below the 85% alarm floor.
The fix adds `free_watermark_pct` config knob (defaults to 0 for no behavior change) with clamped max of 50%, allowing per-deployment opt-in at 20 for the review-bot service.
